statement: A commercial or tanker vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz will suffer a reported kinetic attack (missile, mine, drone strike, or armed seizure) between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-17.
resolution: True if two or more independent wire services (Reuters, AP, Bloomberg) report a kinetic attack or seizure against a Hormuz-transiting vessel occurring between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-17, confirmed by 2026-08-20.
failure_condition: No such attack or seizure on a Hormuz-transiting vessel is confirmed by two independent wire services within the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: Israel and Palestinian armed factions in Gaza will be reported to have observed a continuous halt in strikes lasting at least 48 hours, beginning between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-24.
resolution: True if two or more wire services or the UN report a Gaza ceasefire holding at least 48 continuous hours with a start date between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-24, confirmed by 2026-08-27.
failure_condition: No 48-hour continuous halt in Gaza strikes with a start date in the stated window is confirmed by two independent sources as of the deadline.

statement: A UN body, the ICC, or a major human rights organization will announce it has opened a formal investigation into the 2026-08-03 Sudan army drone strike on a court session, between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-25.
resolution: True if the UN, ICC, or a named human rights organization publicly announces a formal investigation or fact-finding inquiry into the strike, with the announcement dated between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-25, confirmed by 2026-08-28.
failure_condition: No formal investigation or fact-finding inquiry into the strike is publicly announced by any of the named bodies within the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb will announce a signed definitive merger or acquisition agreement between 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-04.
resolution: True if both companies issue a joint press release or regulatory filing confirming a signed definitive agreement, dated between 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-04, confirmed by 2026-09-08.
failure_condition: No joint press release or regulatory filing confirming a signed definitive agreement between the two companies appears within the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: The Federal Reserve will raise its federal funds target range above the level in effect on 2026-08-03, in an FOMC decision announced between 2026-08-10 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if an FOMC post-meeting statement dated between 2026-08-10 and 2026-12-31 raises the target range above its 2026-08-03 level, confirmed via the Federal Reserve press release by 2027-01-06.
failure_condition: No FOMC statement dated in the window raises the target range above its 2026-08-03 level as of the deadline.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog will add an entry for the N-able N-central vulnerability described in the 2026-08-03 report, with the addition dated between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-18.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog lists an N-able N-central CVE with a date-added field between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-18, confirmed by checking the catalog on 2026-08-21.
failure_condition: No N-able N-central CVE appears in the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added in the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: A national law enforcement agency (FBI, Europol, or equivalent) will publicly attribute the $88 million Bitcoin theft linked to the COLDCARD wallet RNG flaw to a specific individual, group, or state actor, between 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-01.
resolution: True if a national law enforcement agency issues a public statement, indictment, or advisory attributing the theft to a named actor, dated between 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-01, confirmed by 2026-09-04.
failure_condition: No national law enforcement agency issues a public attribution naming an actor for the theft within the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: The US Senate will hold a floor vote resulting in confirmation or rejection of the pending nomination of Todd Blanche, between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21.
resolution: True if the Senate floor vote record (Congress.gov or a wire service) shows a confirmation or rejection vote on the nomination of Todd Blanche dated between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21, confirmed by 2026-08-24.
failure_condition: No Senate floor vote on the nomination of Todd Blanche, up or down, is recorded within the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: The wildfire(s) reported destroying homes and forcing evacuations near Spokane, Washington on 2026-08-03 will reach full containment, as reported by state or federal fire authorities, between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21.
resolution: True if Washington state fire authorities or InciWeb report the Spokane-area wildfire(s) at 100 percent containment, with the containment date between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21, confirmed by 2026-08-24.
failure_condition: No state or federal fire authority reports 100 percent containment of the Spokane-area wildfire(s) with a containment date in the stated window as of the deadline.

statement: WTI crude oil will close (NYMEX front-month settlement) below 75.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21.
resolution: True if the NYMEX front-month WTI settlement price closes below 75.00 on any trading day between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21, per exchange or wire-service data, confirmed by 2026-08-24.
failure_condition: No NYMEX front-month WTI settlement between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21 closes below 75.00 per barrel, as of the deadline.
